UI_RelaxedAim_PressKeyHint: Press a key to bind it, or Esc to cancel.
UI_RelaxedAim_LockOn_desc: When ON, automatically locks onto the closest zombie near your aim point and smoothly moves the crosshair to its head. When OFF, only HUD info is shown.
UI_RelaxedAim_ToggleKey_desc: Press to toggle aim assist on/off on the fly. Click the key and press a new key to change it.
UI_RelaxedAim_LockRadius_desc: A zombie is locked when it is within this distance (in meters) of your aim point.
UI_RelaxedAim_MaxLockDistance_desc: Zombies farther than this (in meters) from your character are never locked (also limited by weapon range).
UI_RelaxedAim_LockHoldTimeMs_desc: When a locked zombie briefly becomes invalid (occluded), keep the lock for this many milliseconds before releasing. 0 = release immediately.
UI_RelaxedAim_ShotgunNoLock: Disable lock-on while aiming a shotgun
UI_RelaxedAim_ShotgunNoLock_desc: When ON, aiming with a shotgun (typically used for area damage) disables the aim lock-on.
